title: About This Site
subtitle: Classy Marty — built with Angular 22, Material M3, and a pinch of magic ✨

sections.heading: The Stack
sections.content: Built with Angular 22 and Angular Material 3 (M3) with a warm orange theme generated from themes.angular-material.dev. The honeycomb background and bee favicon are a nod to the 'Classy' brand — bees are efficient, organized, and get the job done. Hosted on GitHub Pages with a custom 404.html redirect trick so refreshing any route doesn't give you a 404.

sections.heading: The Poor Man's CMS
sections.content: No database, no backend, no API keys to rotate. Just JSON files in the public/data/ folder. A ContentService fetches them via HTTP at runtime, and Angular renders the data into components using signals and @for loops. Want to update your resume? Edit resume.json, push, done. It's the simplest CMS in the world — a text editor and a git push. Perfect for a personal site that doesn't need a full CMS but doesn't want hardcoded HTML either.

sections.heading: The Evolution
sections.content: This site started as flat HTML/CSS back in 2025 (classy-site-2025), graduated to Angular 18 (classy-site), got a modern rebuild with Angular 21 + Material 3 (classysite2026), and is now consolidated into this Angular 22 version. Each iteration taught me something new about Angular, component architecture, and the joy of watching a JSON file turn into a fully styled page.

sections.heading: The JSON-Driven Pages
sections.content: Resume data lives in public/data/resume.json — experience, education, skills, projects, all in clean JSON. The component loops over it with @for, rendering MatCards with company logos, responsibilities lists, and section headers. No templates to update when you land a new job. Just add an entry to the JSON array.
